However, examining the wrapper in `memory_helpers.sh` (lines 195-222) shows the intentional fail-open design:; - When the Python script fails (non-zero exit), the wrapper returns `{"result": {"blocked": false, ...}}`; - This is the designed behavior to prevent the system from blocking on transient errors; - Telemetry with `"ok":false,"fail_open":true` is emitted by the wrapper; This is not a bug - it's the intended fail-safe behavior.; ## SUMMARY; The autofix successfully added telemetry to the missing paths as requested.
